QuestInfo.name: Not a Dream
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage breaks free of his seals and disappears. You've failed...
QuestInfo.1: The Black Mage breaks free of his seals and disappears. Time to tell Athena Pierce...
QuestInfo.2: You tell Athena Pierce everything: the Black Mage's words, the way the seal broke before you could fix it, the Black Mage's disapperance. \r\nIt all seems like a dream, but it wasn't.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Speak with Athena Pierce at the Three Doors

0.0: ...\r\nOh boy. The Black Mage is free. This is bad...
0.1: But Athena Pierce can fix it, right? Right? Fingers crossed...

yes.0: Athena Pierce should still be at the Gate of the Present.

1.0: #h0#, you're as pale as a ghost. And... you still have the Seal Stone. What happened? \r\n#L0##b(You hand her the stone and fill her in. You're not quite able to meet her eyes.)#l\n#k
1.1: So the Black Mage is finally awake...

yes.0: We need to let the others know. You must be tired, #h0#. Please... Go rest. I will handle the rest.
